name: Ploughed Edge
description: Turned brown soil meets a green field under a pale, even sky. A quiet, wide frame that suits a long wall.

name: First Frost
description: A frozen field at first light, the hedgerows still dark and the grass silvered with frost.

name: The Long Track
description: A pale farm track runs straight through flat fields toward a deep blue sky. Portrait format.

name: Wheat Under Weather
description: Golden wheat beneath dark trees while a storm builds overhead. Warm in the foreground, heavy above.

name: Crop Lines
description: An aerial view of diagonal crop rows in olive and straw gold. Square format, close to abstract.

name: Tea Terraces
description: Rows of tea bushes wrap a plantation hillside in tight green curves. Portrait format.

name: Last Load
description: A tractor pulls the last trailer of hay bales across a cut field under a clear sky.

name: The Flock
description: A shepherd walks his flock through rolling green hills with the woods closing in behind.

name: Seed Heads
description: A field of dandelion clocks backlit by a bright sky, just before the wind takes them. Portrait format.
